prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
engine_stated_criteria: all Marketplace plans available for your ZIP code
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for individual or family coverage: it’s an independent Kansas City–area agency, serves both sides of the state line, and lists a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. Call **816-205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

Another option is **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** in Overland Park, which says it compares multiple carriers and helps with Marketplace subsidies. Call **913-333-8627** or visit [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/).

Before enrolling, ask whether they’ll compare **all Marketplace plans available for your ZIP code**, check your doctors and prescriptions, and explain any commission or plan limitations. If you qualify for income-based savings, make sure the plan is through the ACA Marketplace—off-Marketplace plans generally don’t receive those subsidies.
